name: Grow A Forest 🌲
desc:
🌲 Welcome to Grow A Forest 🌲

Are you ready to grow your very own forest? Buy tree seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, wait for them to grow, and collect the fruits! Flex plots and finds on friends, and have fun!

[🌱 How To Plant 🌱]
• Equip the tree seed you want to plant!
• Click in your farm on the brown plots to plant!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, harvest the goods!

⭐ Remember, your forest literally grows while you are offline!
